subject: Intro + quick demo — aligning times and agenda
body:
--- Message 1 of 5 ---
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@olivetech.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo?

Hi Vivek,

I signed up for a trial yesterday (Olive Tech / lina.t) and our team is evaluating inference options for a latency-sensitive customer-facing feature. The onboarding looked straightforward, but before we commit to a pilot we need a short product walkthrough focused on: deployment options (hosted vs private), latency profiles with batch vs single-request patterns, and integration points for our auth/SSO.

I'm based in PDT and have availability this week after 2pm most days. If it's helpful, I can include our infra lead (ops@olivetech.com).

Thanks — would love a 30-min slot to see a focused demo.

Best,
Lina
Customer Success Manager
Olive Tech

--- Message 2 of 5 ---
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@olivetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo?

Hi Lina — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for signing up and for the context. I looped in Marissa (SDR) for calendar coordination and Ben (copied later) will join the call if you want a short infra/ops sync.

Available 30-min windows this week (PDT):
- Tue Aug 10, 11:00am–11:30am
- Tue Aug 10, 3:30pm–4:00pm
- Wed Aug 11, 2:00pm–2:30pm

If none of those work, tell us two 1-hour ranges and we’ll match. I also attached a short pre-demo questionnaire that helps us tailor the session (attachment: Pre-demo Questionnaire.pdf).

Calendly / quick schedule: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123-schedule

Agenda (proposed)
- 5m intros & goals
- 10m demo: hosted vs private deployments (latency/cost tradeoffs)
- 10m integration/SSO and security checklist
- 5m next steps / PoC planning

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

--- Message 3 of 5 ---
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@olivetech.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 14:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo?

Thanks Vivek — appreciate the quick reply.

Those Tue afternoon slots are tight for our infra lead; they can do earlier in the morning (PDT) or late afternoon (PDT). For example: Tue Aug 10 9:00–10:00am or 4:30–5:30pm would work. Wed afternoon might be okay but we prefer Tue if possible.

Also, we'd like the agenda to include a quick note on data residency (where logs/metrics live) and key audit logs for compliance.

Lina

--- Message 4 of 5 ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@olivetech.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo? — alternate windows and next steps

Hi Lina — Marissa here. Comfortable matching a 60-minute slot to include your infra lead so we can cover the audit/logging questions thoroughly. Ben will take the lead on the security/config portion.

Proposed times (PDT) we can make work:
- Tue Aug 10, 9:00am–10:00am  (fits your infra lead suggestion)
- Tue Aug 10, 4:30pm–5:30pm

Please confirm one and we'll send a calendar invite with a short pre-read (and confirm who should be on the call). If you'd prefer, we can split: 30m product demo + 30m technical deep-dive.

Also linking a lightweight mutual action plan we use for pilots: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/OLIVE-2027-117

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole | SDR, Redwood Inference

--- Message 5 of 5 ---
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@olivetech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick demo? — alternate windows and next steps

Hi Marissa, Vivek — thanks, Tue Aug 10 9:00–10:00am (PDT) works for us. Please include Ben on the invite.

For the agenda, can we add:
- SSO options (SAML, Okta integration)
- Expected retention of audit logs and whether logs are exportable to our SIEM

I attached a short doc with our SSO questions (attachment: SAML-questions.docx). Looking forward to the walkthrough — send the invite and we'll accept.

Best,
Lina
Olive Tech

--- End of thread ---
